name: GOES (NOAA Weather)
tagline: NOAA geostationary weather pair — Americas continuous coverage
description: Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite — NOAA's geostationary weather pair. GOES-East at 75.2° W and GOES-West at 137.0° W give continuous coverage of the Americas. Current generation GOES-R series (GOES-16, 17, 18, 19) carries the Advanced Baseline Imager capable of 30-second mesoscale scans for hurricane cores and severe-storm tracking. Built by Lockheed Martin; data products freely available.
best_known_for: NOAA geostationary weather pair — Americas continuous coverage
